text:
Maya: Hi team! First day here. Two quick things: who owns RBAC for service accounts across Hosted vs Private? And who controls feature-flag rollouts for model variants (Hosted/Dedicated)? Also: if we hit a sustained latency SLO breach on hosted inference, what's the immediate escalation path?

Felipe: welcome @Maya :wave: RBAC split is basically security-eng for policy + eng-infra for cloud bindings. For hosted vs private surface-level differences we keep separate project groups.

Robin: hi @Maya. Feature flags for model variants are owned by eng-platform (flag config + rollout tooling) but product owns flag gating logic for experiments. For Dedicated-specific routing, eng-runtime coordinates.

Maya: ok — so who do I ping to add a service account with inference scopes?

Claire: ping eng-infra (cc @Felipe). Give the service account name, project, and minimal roles. Example we usually ask for: ```sa: svc-maya-dev roles: roles/storage.objectViewer,roles/ml.inferenceUser notes: ephemeral test only```

Felipe: for RBAC exceptions (temporary elevated access) you open infra-triage and tag security-eng + your manager. Add justification and expiry.

Maya: and the SLO breach path? If hosted API latency above 95th for >10m who gets paged?

Robin: pager flow: host-monitor -> #eng-oncall (2m ack window). If unacked -> #eng-sre-secondary (10m) -> eng-platform lead. We also have an auto-failover policy that can route traffic to a lower-cost variant or Dedicated pool if configured. See runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/hosted-latency.

infra-bot: PagerPolicy: hosted-latency-alert -> #eng-oncall (2m) -> secondary (10m) -> eng-platform (20m). Auto-escalation to ops-director at 45m.

Claire: for feature-flag rollouts, eng-platform uses canary windows and automated rollback if error rate or latency exceeds thresholds. If you need a prescheduled rollout for onboarding tests, file a booking at https://go/redwood/flagbookings with tag "onboard:test".

Maya: perfect. Any one-page matrix that maps "who-to-ask" for common surfaces (RBAC, flags, capacity, oncall)? Would be super helpful to pin in my notes.

Felipe: yes — we have a compact matrix in the onboarding folder. Quick map from me here: RBAC -> eng-infra/security-eng; Service accounts -> eng-infra; Flag rollouts -> eng-platform/product; Capacity/Dedicated seats -> eng-platform/bookings; Oncall/escalation -> eng-sre. I'll DM the link and drop it in the onboarding doc.

Maya: awesome, thanks y'all! Tagging for my checklist :white_check_mark:
